scenarios.label: Internal tutorial
scenarios.description: Teach a concept or method to the group.

scenarios.label: Internal research
scenarios.description: Discuss research questions, methods and results.

scenarios.label: External presentation
scenarios.description: Present to an audience outside the group.

audiences.label: Experts
priorities: Make methods, assumptions and uncertainty checkable.
Foreground the contribution and comparable evidence.

audiences.label: C-suite / executives
priorities: Keep evidence, risk and limitations accessible.
Include financial or operational claims only when the source supports them.

audiences.label: General audience
priorities: Define unfamiliar concepts and explain mechanisms intuitively.
Keep the finding and essential qualifications visible.

depths.label: Let palate choose
depths.description: Choose depth from the audience, time and source content.

depths.label: Key takeaways
depths.description: Prioritize clear findings and essential explanation.

depths.label: Full technical detail
depths.description: Keep methods and derivations available for close discussion.
